messages:
Alyssa B: FYI invoice INV-2026-3012 from Pelago shows a one-time onboarding surcharge we billed as "reserved-provision". Customer says they only used 40% of reserved capacity during pilot and requests a pro-rated credit.
Tom R: How big is the disputed amount? Need dollars & support ticket.
Alyssa B: Disputed line = $6,400 (reserved fee). Customer asks for 75% credit on that line = $4,800. They offered to sign a 4-month committed pilot at 20% discount if we grant partial relief.
Hannah J: ops ticket? provisioning logs?
finance-bot: <https://support.redwood.com/ticket/PRV-3312|PRV-3312> attached utilization graphs showing avg 38% for Jan pilot window.
Hannah J: Looks like underutilization partly due to missing autoscale config on customer side and partly because sales overestimated load. Shared responsibility.
Tom R: Proposal: approve a one-time pro-rated credit of 50% of disputed line ($3,200), capped at $3,500. Conditions: (1) Customer signs pilot commitment addendum (4 months) in SFDC, (2) Sales to schedule onboarding to enable autoscale, (3) Finance to post GL code ADJ-PILOT-01.
Alyssa B: Sales accepts conditions. I'll get addendum signed and attach to OPP-7723.
legal-bot: Please note: require addendum to include explicit no-further-claims clause and 30-day clawback if commitment not met.
Tom R: Approver note: Approved one-time credit $3,200 (50% of disputed line), cap $3,500. Conditions as stated; Approver: Tom R.
Hannah J: Finance action: create credit memo CM-2026-4120, GL ADJ-PILOT-01, add note "pilot pro-rate credit per Deal Desk 2026-03-11".
Alyssa B: Notifying customer and starting signature workflow. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
